senses.zh_definition: 费利克斯；人名，通常用作男性名字，正文通常写作 Felix。
senses.en_definition: Felix, a personal name usually used as a masculine given name.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama lelaki dan ditulis dengan huruf awal besar, Felix.
senses.nuances: 此处按专有名词处理；输入缺少上下文，不能确定具体指谁，也不能排除姓氏、品牌或其他专名用法。拉丁语词源有幸运之义，但在马来语句子中不能把 Felix 当作 bertuah 的普通同义词。以下为自然称名组合，不代表经语料统计的高频固定搭配。[Felix 姓名资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/felix)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Felix akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 费利克斯先生将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Felix will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Felix dah sampai kat kafe, jom pergi sekarang.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Felix sudah tiba di kafe; marilah kita pergi sekarang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 费利克斯已经到咖啡馆了，我们现在过去吧。
dual_scenarios.en: Felix is already at the café. Let's head over now.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Felix dah sampai kat kafe ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Felix sudah tiba di kafe?
messages.zh: 费利克斯到咖啡馆了吗？
messages.en: Has Felix arrived at the café yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia nak tunggu kita kat luar je.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, dia mahu menunggu kita di luar sahaja.
messages.zh: 到了，他说就在外面等我们。
messages.en: Yes, he's going to wait for us outside.

etymology.historical_story: Felix comes from Latin felix, associated with being fortunate or happy. It became a personal name and was borne by numerous early Christian saints. Its appearance in a Malay sentence therefore need not indicate a Malay vocabulary item: names travel between languages while retaining their identity. The name's historical meaning does not describe every person who bears it. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/felix)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Felix 的开头 Fe 联想成中文姓氏“费”，记作“费利克斯”；整词认作人名，不拆成马来语词根和词缀。
